meta.title: DSH Git
meta.description: One clean git and GitHub surface: a single `git` tool for clone, init, status, save, publish, sync, pull requests, merges, finish and prune, plus two automatic behaviours that remove the failure modes this profile kept hitting. A few seconds after a turn's edits stop, its changed files are committed and, when the branch is safe to push, pushed - so no work is left dirty or unsynced because a session forgot. A guard watches `bash` and redirects raw mutating git at the tool that does it consistently, denying the commands that discard work another session may still hold, and denying the mutating forms of subcommands the tool has no action for instead of waving them through. `status` reports the worktrees git knows about and the open pull request. How to use: ask the agent for the `git` tool, or type /git in the composer to print the working tree state. Auto-commit, auto-push, guard strictness, branch prefix, protected branches and timeouts are all set by overriding this bundle's row in the profile's own patch layer.
